catalog.label: Set variable
catalog.note: Stores a volatile device-global value. The Value is resolved when the action runs.

catalog.label: Device command
catalog.note: Connect to Wi-Fi turns Wi-Fi on and tries the configured network, replacing AP. Disconnect from Wi-Fi turns Wi-Fi off but leaves an active AP unchanged. Turn off Wi-Fi stops both network and AP access; Bluetooth remains available. Commands acknowledge a request, not readiness, and do not change the saved operating mode. Enable AP keeps the current pad; Restart into AP enters recovery.

catalog.label: Gamepad
catalog.note: USB or BLE HID transport required. tap waits for submitted press, 50 ms hold, and submitted release; held targets reject taps. down/up share one standalone latch per control, independent of widget holds. Pad exit, replacement, disconnect, and OTA clear holds.

arguments.name: wrap
arguments.label: Wrap at first or last pad

catalog.label: Send BTHome event
catalog.note: Unencrypted Bluetooth broadcast; no delivery acknowledgement. Independent of MQTT. Four waiting events; rejects newest when full.

editor_fields.name: button
editor_fields.label: Button number
editor_fields.help: Device-wide number. Match Button 1-10 in Home Assistant.

editor_fields.name: event
editor_fields.label: Event
editor_fields.help: Sends the selected event immediately over Bluetooth. Match this button number and event in your Home Assistant automation.

editor_fields.name: alarm_value
editor_fields.label: Minutes (set time: since midnight; adjust: signed step)

editor_fields.name: sound_alert_pattern
editor_fields.label: Tone pattern
editor_fields.help: Repeats until stopped. Stop audio stops playback; Dismiss alarm ends the alarm session.

editor_fields.name: sound_alert_file
editor_fields.label: MP3 file
editor_fields.help: Repeats until stopped. Stop audio stops playback; Dismiss alarm ends the alarm session.

catalog.label: Recording
catalog.note: Toggle starts a recording when idle, or stops and saves a recording, including when paused. Commands are rejected during transitions.

catalog.label: Process saved notes
catalog.note: Starts a background pass for missing results without waiting for completion. Offline or busy requests schedule nothing.

catalog.label: Delete saved note
catalog.note: Permanently deletes a saved note. Use [item:id] for a List item.

catalog.label: Load saved note
catalog.note: Loads one shared snapshot in the background. Use [item:id] for a List item.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Raw number or text; absent when unavailable

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit of the raw value, or empty for text

fields.name: severity
fields.description: normal, warning, critical, or unknown; absent for informational rows

fields.name: has_enrichment
fields.description: Whether title and summary data exists
